description: Import and Export Control Department - Correction Notice to the Extra Gazette No. 2270/18 of 09.03.2022
categorisation: This gazette content is a correction notice for the "Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations" under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act. It involves the amendment and correction of existing regulations, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or other specialized categories, making Legal/Regulatory (Type 5) the appropriate classification.
